text: A resident pushes her tray of grey mash away again. "Not hungry, dear." {boss} taps a watch.

up.label: Bring her favourite meal from home

risk.result: Against the rules. {boss} gives you a warning.

text: A resident's son slips you a fat envelope. "For looking after Dad." Policy says no gifts.

risk.result: {boss} found out.

up.label: Report it and ask for a formal reward

risk.result: HR starts an inquiry into you.

text: A ward is demanding a bed that does not exist. {boss} says find one. The corridor is empty.

risk.result: You paid for it later.

up.label: Reorganise the ward's beds yourself

risk.result: Wrong ward. Wrong patient. Wrong day.

text: {friend} knows a shortcut through the loading bay. Saves ten minutes. The door says staff only.

risk.result: Security caught you.

up.label: Map every shortcut and sell the map

risk.result: Security finds out. Everyone does.

text: Three call bells ring at once. {rival} is on break. Again. Their coffee is still steaming.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Rewire the rota yourself

risk.result: {rival} and half the shift go on strike.

text: {friend} offers to show you how to take blood. They grin. "Don't faint. The last one fainted."

up.label: Sit the exam this month

risk.result: You fail by two marks.

text: The sat nav says left. {friend} says right. The siren screams. Someone out there isn't breathing.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Radio dispatch and take a third route

risk.result: Wrong again. Someone waits too long.

text: You did everything right, by the book. It wasn't enough. Nobody turns the radio on for the drive back.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Request time off and volunteer for the review

risk.result: The review blames the wrong crew.

text: You glance at the chart and freeze. {rival} wrote ten times the dose. The patient hasn't had it yet.

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Rewrite the procedure for the whole ward

risk.result: You are now the nurse who writes everyone up.

text: Fourth night shift in a row. The vending machine is out of crisps. {crush} brings you a coffee at 4am.

risk.result: You paid for it later.

up.label: Ask them out for breakfast, right now

risk.result: They say no. Loudly, in the corridor.

text: The prescription looks off. The signature's wrong, the ink still wet. The man drums on the counter.

risk.result: It was forged.

up.label: Call the police and keep them talking

risk.result: The customer is not happy to be kept.

death.cause: The man at the counter had a knife.

text: An old man tips twelve pill bottles onto the counter. He asks if he really needs all of them.

up.label: Run a free medication review clinic

risk.result: Head office says you've broken policy.

text: A kid in the chair bites {boss}'s finger and won't let go. {boss} squeaks. Everyone looks at you.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Sing the kid the loudest song you know

risk.result: Half the room joins. Half the room cries.

text: {rival} is spreading a rumour about you and {crush}. The receptionist winks at you. Twice.

risk.result: You paid for it later.

up.label: Start a rumour about {rival} right back

risk.result: Everyone sees what you've done.

text: {boss} wants more veneers sold. Your patient has perfectly good teeth and trusts you completely.

up.label: Expose the upsell to the patients

risk.result: {boss} lets you go on the spot.

text: Years of leaning over chairs, peering into mouths. Your back clicks when you stand. It's complaining.

up.label: Open your own practice with a chair that adjusts

risk.result: The loan is longer than the lease.

text: Midnight. A farmer's cow is calving badly in a muddy shed. It's raining sideways.

up.label: Take {rival} and film the whole thing

risk.result: The cow kicks. The camera breaks.

text: A man counts coins onto the counter for his cat's surgery. He counts twice. He's short.

up.label: Set up a free surgery fund

risk.result: The fund drains faster than it fills.

text: Everyone says it's a virus and the bed is needed. Something about the rash bothers you.

up.label: Stake your reputation and order an MRI

risk.result: Nothing found. The hospital invoice, though.

text: Hour 30 of your shift. You've read the same chart three times. The coffee went cold hours ago.

risk.result: You made a mistake.
It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Take a stimulant and finish the list

risk.result: Your hands shake. Your patient's chart is wrong.

text: Your regular client cancels for the third week. The text is short, no emoji. They always use emoji.

up.label: Turn up at their house

risk.result: Boundary breach. The board is informed.

text: {boss} flicks through your notes, stopping on a page with one line. "These are... thin."

up.label: Ask to present a case at conference

risk.result: A panel rips it to pieces. Politely.

text: It's scorching. The steel burns to touch. {boss} wants the slab poured before lunch.

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Lead a vote to start at 4am

risk.result: {boss} calls it mutiny.

text: The frame's a few millimetres out. The bubble sits just off centre, smugly. Nobody would ever know.

up.label: Rebuild the whole frame and bill {boss}

risk.result: {boss} refuses to pay. The frame stays.

text: {boss} swears the circuit's dead and reaches for the wires. Your tester beeps red. It disagrees.

risk.result: It wasn't dead.
You paid for it later.

up.label: Test it with your bare hands to prove a point

risk.result: The circuit was live.

text: The new apprentice has wired the switch upside down. Up is off. They are beaming with pride.

up.label: Hand them the whole job

risk.result: The wiring sparks. The customer is not happy.

text: 3am. Burst pipe, water through the ceiling. The caller is crying too hard to say the address.

up.label: Go, and fix the whole street's pipes

risk.result: Mains flooded. You pay for it.

text: You pull a clump of hair and soap out of the drain. Something glints. A diamond ring, slimy and real.

risk.result: The owner noticed.

up.label: Advertise it and claim the reward

risk.result: Two people claim it. Court follows.

text: Hammer. Thumb. You make a noise you didn't know you could. {rival} laughs so hard they sit down.

up.label: Rig a safety guard and sell the design

risk.result: The prototype takes a different thumb.

text: The stairs are due Friday. It's Thursday. Right now they're a pile of planks and a doodle.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Hire a team for the night

risk.result: They quit at midnight. Stairs half done.

text: {boss} wants you to tell an old lady she needs new brakes. She doesn't. She offers you a biscuit.

up.label: Tell her to get a second opinion in public

risk.result: {boss} loses the customer and blames you.

text: "It makes a noise." That's all the customer says. Then they make a vague whooshing face.

up.label: Strip the whole engine and find it

risk.result: It was a loose cable. You rebuilt the engine.

text: Forty covers at once. {boss} is shouting. {rival} has burnt the risotto. The smoke alarm wonders.

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Take over the pass

risk.result: Chaos. Plates fly. {boss} watches.

text: The steak slides off the tongs and slaps the floor. You look around. Nobody saw. It's an expensive steak.

risk.result: The diner found a hair.

up.label: Turn it into a stew special

risk.result: Food poisoning in a table of six.

text: Hour fourteen at the wheel. The radio is static and the white lines are starting to dance.

up.label: Call it in and hand the keys to the night crew

risk.result: The load is late. The client is furious.

text: A soaked hitchhiker on the verge, cardboard sign melting in the rain. Company rules say no.

risk.result: Your wallet left with them.

up.label: Drive them home and take a detour

risk.result: Dash cam. {boss}. A very long meeting.

death.cause: The hitchhiker was not who they said.

text: Third dry month. The fields look like toast. The water tank clangs hollow when you knock it.

up.label: Drill a new well

risk.result: You strike water, deep and clean.

text: A calf is coming backwards. It's 2am, the shed light flickers and {friend} is asleep in the house.

up.label: Call the vet and run the whole herd check

risk.result: Three more cows are sick. All at once.

text: The office party ended at midnight. There's cake on the ceiling and a shoe in a plant pot. You start at 5.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Pitch to take over the whole cleaning contract

risk.result: You take it. You can't staff it.

text: A diamond ring, behind the toilet in a rich client's marble bathroom. The house is silent.

risk.result: They had a camera.

up.label: Hand it in and ask for a testimonial

risk.result: They say you stole it and fire you.

text: The scanner beeps: you're 12% under quota. Your feet ache. {boss} is watching your number on the big screen.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Reorganise the aisle layout

risk.result: The scanner is confused. {boss} is not happy.

text: {rival} reverses the forklift into a pallet of TVs. Crunch. Tinkle. Then they turn and point at you.

up.label: Take the forklift licence course and the lead

risk.result: You fail the practical in front of {rival}.

text: The printer jams again and eats a page with a grinding noise. {boss} looks straight at you.

up.label: Replace the whole fleet with your own proposal

risk.result: The new printers jam worse.

text: Two directors booked the same room for the same hour. Both stand at the door. Both booked it first.

up.label: Build a booking tool overnight

risk.result: It crashes in front of the directors.

text: Last day of the month. You're one sale short of quota. The office is emptying. The phone is right there.

up.label: Offer a deal that breaks the rules

risk.result: Compliance. A meeting. A suit.

text: {rival} is about to close YOUR client, using the lead from your notes. And your jokes.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Undercut {rival}'s deal at once

risk.result: The client sees through it. Both of you lose.

text: Your till is twenty short at close. You count it three times. Nobody's watching the cameras.

up.label: Cover it, and count every till every night

risk.result: You find the error. It's yours. It's big.

text: A frail old woman wants all her savings in cash. Her "grandson" waits outside, engine running.

up.label: Walk her to the police station

risk.result: The 'grandson' was real. You've caused a scene.

text: A young family needs a loan. The baby chews your pen. Their numbers are... hopeful.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Sponsor them personally

risk.result: They default. You're on the hook.

text: Bonus season. {rival} leaves their letter open on the desk. Their bonus is bigger than yours. Much.

up.label: Take the competing offer to {boss}

risk.result: {boss} lets you walk. The offer was a bluff.

text: Tax season. Your inbox has 214 unread, half marked urgent. It's 9pm and your eyes itch.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Automate the lot

risk.result: A bug miscalculates forty returns.

text: A client hands you receipts for a jet ski and a pony. They want you to get 'creative' with expenses.

risk.result: The audit found it.

up.label: Turn them in and become the informant

risk.result: The client has friends. They know your address.

text: The filing deadline is 5pm. It's 4:40. The courier texts you a photo of a traffic jam.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Hire a motorbike courier at triple the fee

risk.result: The bike gets a puncture. Five-oh-two.

text: {boss} presents your research to the partners as their own. Coffee stain and all. They're impressed.

up.label: Present your research directly to the partners

risk.result: {boss} makes you pay. Quietly. For a year.

text: Your client leans in and whispers, off the record, that they did it. Then asks how the case is going.

up.label: Report them to the court

risk.result: Privilege breach. You're struck off for a year.

text: {boss} wants 2,000 billable hours this year. You're on track for 1,600, counting naps at your desk.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Bill triple for the big case

risk.result: The partners audit you.

text: Friday, 5:55pm. The website is down. Your last change went in at 5:50. The phones start ringing.

up.label: Roll back the whole release and own it

risk.result: You roll back the wrong release.

text: {rival} leaves 47 comments on your code review. Most are about spacing. One just says "hmm".

up.label: Rewrite the module from scratch

risk.result: The rewrite has twice the bugs.

text: Ticket #4,112: 'computer broken. URGENT.' You climb three floors. It's unplugged. They're watching.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Write a video guide and send it to everyone

risk.result: It goes round the company. Everybody knows who it's about.

text: The server upgrade has to happen overnight. Someone has to stay with the humming racks and cold pizza.

up.label: Migrate the whole stack in one night

risk.result: Monday: nothing works.

text: {boss} wants the new campaign to 'go viral', like the cat videos. Budget: zero. {boss} is thrilled.

left.label: Explain that's not how it works

up.label: Stage a stunt on live TV

risk.result: It goes viral. For the wrong reasons.

text: Pitch meeting in ten minutes. Through the glass, {rival} is rehearsing your idea, word for word.

up.label: Take their slide deck and present it better

risk.result: You freeze mid-slide. {rival} grins.

text: Ninety essays on the same poem. Sunday night, cold tea. Essay forty-one compares it to a sandwich.

up.label: Mark them with a robot and do the lesson plan

risk.result: The robot marked a poem about a poem as an F.

text: A parent tells {boss} their kid "deserved an A". The kid copied half of it. {boss} wants a word.

up.label: Invite the parent to sit in on the class

risk.result: They film you. It's on the internet by lunch.

text: You pull over a speeder. It's {friend}'s mother. She's already crying and offering you a muffin.

up.label: Escort her home with your lights on

risk.result: Misuse of a vehicle. A disciplinary.

text: {rival} slides cash from an evidence bag into his jacket. He looks up. He sees you see it.

risk.result: An internal inquiry names you too.

up.label: Wear a wire and take the case upstairs

risk.result: The station turns on you. Even the tea lady.

death.cause: The wire was found. So were you.

text: Smoke pours from the upstairs windows. Neighbours in dressing gowns. Someone screams there's a dog inside.

up.label: Go in with the thermal camera and take the lead

risk.result: A floor gives way. You are lucky.

death.cause: The floor gave way. So did the exit.

text: {friend} signs you up for the charity calendar. Shirtless. Holding a hose. The fan is already on.

up.label: Be Mr November and the fundraiser

risk.result: The picture is on every bus stop.

text: A toddler bites another toddler. Then looks at you. Then, holding eye contact, bites again.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Hold a circle time on feelings

risk.result: Everyone bites. Three parents call.

text: Twelve kids, all asleep at once on little mats. It's never happened before. You don't dare breathe.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Take the class on an impromptu outing

risk.result: You lose a child. Briefly. Very briefly.

text: A customer wants a refund on a toaster. It's full of water. There's a rubber duck in the slot.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Give her the toaster and a coupon

risk.result: She tells all her friends. All of them come.

text: An old man in a thin coat slips a tin of soup into his pocket. His hands are shaking.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Buy it for him and follow him home

risk.result: He does it again next week. And the week after.

text: {rival} posts their latte art: a swan, wings spread, perfect neck. It's annoyingly good.

up.label: Enter the city barista contest

risk.result: Eighth of eight. The judges are polite.

text: Your 7am regular hasn't come in for a week. Today she's back, red-eyed, gripping her purse.

up.label: Take her to coffee on your day off

risk.result: She's grieving. You leave in tears.

text: The client wants the logo bigger. And the other logo bigger. And both to pop. By voice note.

up.label: Make both logos fill the page

risk.result: It's an ugly poster. It's in the paper.

text: {rival} clicks to the next slide. It's your poster, your hidden doodle and all. "So I made this."

up.label: Present your own version first at the next meeting

risk.result: {rival} won't speak to you for a month.

text: A brown envelope on your desk, no name. Inside: the mayor's expenses. All of them. Even the hot tub.

up.label: Publish it with the documents

risk.result: A lawsuit and an injunction.

text: The police want your source's name, and they're not asking nicely. Your source is {friend}.

up.label: Go to jail rather than name them

risk.result: A week in a cell. The story runs.

text: Orders come in, stamped and stapled. Your unit deploys next month. The barracks goes very quiet.

risk.result: You were wounded on patrol.

up.label: Volunteer for the forward team

risk.result: The forward team takes hits.

death.cause: The forward team did not all come home.

text: 5am drill in freezing rain, boots full of water. {rival} is slacking at the back, hiding.

up.label: Take over the drill and run it harder

risk.result: You pull a muscle. And the squad.

text: {boss} hands you a list of your team in a cheerful font. Cut three names by Friday.

up.label: Resign in protest and take the three with you

risk.result: Nobody is hiring four people at once.

text: The board wants growth this quarter. Twelve suits wait for your slide. The numbers say no.

risk.result: The auditors noticed.

up.label: Go to the press with the real numbers

risk.result: You never work in this industry again.
